title: Convergence inspection board
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landing-page hero illustration. Scene: an abstract desktop synchronization inspection board on warm paper, with three colored local device and folder tracks feeding into a central glass viewing aperture. Two tracks line up precisely; one red notched paper tab visibly diverges to communicate a conflict. No people. Style and materials: neo-brutalist editorial still life, thick cut paper, black screen-printed rules, translucent inspection glass, tiny metal fasteners, tactile imperfect ink registration marks. Composition: landscape, apparatus weighted right-of-center with breathing room, clear silhouette and strong legibility at small size. Lighting: flat overhead product lighting with slight oblique depth, crisp hard shadows, 50mm-equivalent graphic still life. Palette: warm cream paper, near-black ink, acid signal yellow, cobalt blue, restrained forest green, conflict red. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logos, no brands, no people, no cloud symbol, no glossy 3D, no purple gradient, no neon, no pseudo-interface.
